# Uplift Modelling

::: {.hero-lead}
A treatment-effect modeling project focused on identifying where intervention is likely to create true incremental response.
:::

::: {.metrics-grid}
::: {.detail-card}
### Objective
Separate customers who are persuadable from those unlikely to change behavior.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Methods
Treatment-versus-control framing, uplift scoring, and targeting prioritization.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Outcome
Structured a clearer decision framework for allocating treatment where it is most likely to drive incremental lift.
:::
:::
:::
